name: Overturn Environmental Protection Agency rule: Air Plan Disapproval; Colorado; Regional Haze Plan for the Second Implementation Period
official: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to "Air Plan Disapproval; Colorado; Regional Haze Plan for the Second Implementation Period".
